howto.text:
How to try it

• Press Play, then click inside once so it has the keys.
• The When is quiet grey text after the title and its notes hint; only a deadline is a capsule, at the row's end.
• The checkbox ring: red overdue, amber due today, blue planned for today (outside Today). With both, the deadline's ring outside and a thin blue one inside.
• Hover a date for its full date; click it for the popover.

n_ref.text: Both boards are generated from the prototype's own functions and CSS, so they read exactly as it does. §24 of INTERACTIONS-v2.md is the build spec.

t_detail.text: The detail pane and the popover

n_cal.text:
One column of weeks that scrolls up and down, months running into each other, endless both ways. Six weeks in view; it opens on the selected date's month, as the paged grid did. The header names the month that fills most of the view; other months' days dim. It settles on a week when it comes to rest.

Only the weeks in view and four either side exist; they're made as you scroll.

Try: scroll with the trackpad, far; ↑↓←→; Page Up and Page Down; type “mar 3” or “jan 3 1990”; then Today.

n_cal2.text:
240pt wide instead of 288, the days 32pt apart instead of 39.

The width was set by the quick picks: Today, Tomorrow, Next Week and Clear took 271 of the 272pt inside. Next Week goes (typing “next” or “mon” still gets it), so Today, Tomorrow and Clear fit in 186.

The last line keeps one line: when the date and its words don't fit, ↩ goes, then the weekday, then the relative words.
